about: Contractions split by a space in the Bíblia Livre as eBible.org publishes it (porbr2018_usfx.xml, February 2018 edition): in the USFX the contraction's first letter and the rest are on either side of an <add> boundary with a line break between them, which reads as a space. Versely keeps the publisher's text verbatim (owner, 20 November 2026) and reports them upstream (UPSTREAM_REPORT.md). Test: Tools/BibleData/tests/test_blivre_splits.py.
